fn Power(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 0) then 1 else (2 * Power((n - 1)))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (Power(0) == 1)
  example (Power(1) == 2)
{
  if (n == 0) then 1 else (2 * Power((n - 1)))
}
